name: search_organizations
title: Search organizations
description: Find organizations of Zammad — the inactive ones included — by words of their name or their domain, as Zammad's search finds them. Each row names the organization's ID, domain, VIP flag and number of members; the other tools take the ID, and get_organization reads an organization in detail. Pass next_cursor as cursor, with the same query, for the next organizations.

query.description: Words of a name or a domain, e.g. "Acme" or "acme.example".

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous result, for the next organizations.

sort_by.description: The field to sort by. Otherwise the active organizations first, the newest created first.

order_by.description: The direction: asc for the oldest, earliest or A first, desc for the newest, latest or Z first. Otherwise desc.

url.description: Link to the organization in Zammad.

domain.description: The email domain of its members.

active.description: Only where the organization is inactive.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as cursor, with the same query, for the next organizations.
